# Fallout 76 - Patch notes "Infestations" June 2, 2026 (Patch 68)

![Fallout 76 - Patch notes `Infestations` 06/02/2026 (Patch 68)](/uploads/706_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

# Fallout 76: Infestations – Patch Notes

June 2, 2026

Appalachia is in danger! Various locations are infested with enemies and the wasteland needs YOUR help to eliminate them.
### Hello, Vault Dwellers!

This is a call to action. Appalachia is under threat and needs your help. Opposing factions have appeared in various locations throughout the region, driving out local residents and entrenching themselves there. Do you have enough guts to go out and defend the wasteland?
## Update highlights

**Infestations**: Find and eliminate infestations from challenging enemies to earn 4-star rewards.
**New Seasonal Fish**: Summer, Fall, Winter, Spring: Pay attention to the changing seasons to be lucky enough to catch these new fish.
**Deathclaw C.A.M.P. Pack**: Dangerously adorable and available in the new Deathclaw Pack on Xbox, PlayStation and the Steam Shop.
**Next-Gen Upgrade**: A public testing phase begins in June, leading to the full release in the summer. You can find out more about this update below.
**Season 25: Appalachia Under Siege**: Protect Appalachia and earn seasonal rewards along the way!
### Update version 1.7.25.13 and download sizes

**PC (Steam)**: 10GB
**PC (Microsoft Store)**: 28.1 GB
**Xbox**: 28.1GB
**PlayStation**: 27.4GB

## Test phase on Xbox Series X|S and PlayStation 5

We're excited to announce that we'll be launching public testing for the next-gen versions of the game on Xbox Series X|S and PlayStation 5/PlayStation 5 Pro in June. All players who already own Fallout 76 can download the Xbox Series

- Target frame rate of 60 FPS on Xbox Series X|S, PS5 and PS5 Pro
- Improved display distance
- Improved shadows
- 4K resolution (on compatible displays) on Xbox Series X, Xbox One X and PS5 Pro
- Variable refresh rate (on compatible displays) on Xbox Series S, Xbox Series X, PS5 and PS5 Pro
- PS5 and PS4 Pro gain 1440p support, previous generation platforms continue to support 1080p Please keep an eye on our social media channels for more information on how to participate in the testing phase.

### Now back to the content of today's patch!

## Infestations overview

Infestations are new content and provide an additional source of legendary 4-star items for anyone who has the guts to take on the challenging hordes of enemies. The infestations are aimed specifically at experienced residents of Appalachia and must be discovered while exploring the world. While a look at your map will roughly reveal the area in which you can find an infestation, you'll have to find out exactly where it is. For anyone who wants to hunt for infestations, we recommend creating or joining a public exploration team, as you may have difficulty tracking down the infestations on a server full of other hunters. Exploring together as a team increases your chances because you can then quickly travel to a team member if they spot an infestation.
### Locations

Infestations can appear in Toxic Valley, Forest, Ash Heap, Savage Divide, Bog, and Cranberry Bog. In Appalachia there can also be multiple infestations at the same time,
